correctness.rationale: Verified normalized area polynomial Q=XYZ+(1-X)(1-Y)(1-Z), six mixed corners, and exact local chart Q=xi eta+omega(1-xi-eta). For p=xi eta=ta and xi=p^u, eta=p^(1-u), omega=tb, independently computed |det(d(xi,eta)/d(p,u))|=|log p|, giving t²|log(ta)| da du db. On fixed delta=1/5 box, 0<a<=5/4, 0<b<=5/3, almost-everywhere indicator converges to 1(a+b<1,0<u<1), dominated by C(1+|log a|). L1 local subprobability density/(t² log(1/t)) tends to unit density on 3D simplex chart, mass 1/2 per corner. Maesumi exact scalar F_Q(t)=3t² log(1/t)+O(t²) makes outside-corner conditional mass negligible; normalizing yields corner 1/6, U uniform, density 2 on a+b<1 jointly in TV. Q/t->Beta(2,1) follows from A+B but not novel. The affine-invariant side-uniform domain and finite-threshold delta marking checked.
